_help: Resolutions, statements and projects. Put the PDF in documents/ and write its file name in 'file'. Optional 'cover': a JPG of the first page in documents/covers/ (shown as the preview). type: Statement | Resolution | Project. Optional 'date_label' replaces the displayed date.

items.title: YCDI Masterclass 2027
items.summary: Three days of leadership training in the Republic of San Marino for young political leaders of the IDC-CDI network and allied organizations, with experienced mentors, focused on strategic decision-making, effective policy design and democratic values.

items.title: Statement Regarding the Border Armed Conflict Between Cambodia and Thailand
items.summary: The YCDI welcomes the ceasefire agreements of July and August 2025, supports the role of ASEAN in restoring peace, calls for immediate humanitarian assistance for affected civilians and urges both countries to uphold the ceasefire and international law.

items.title: Venezuela in Democracy Project
items.summary: An initiative of the YCDI and the Mariano Ospina Pérez Foundation to strengthen the political leadership and defend the political rights of young Venezuelans in exile, amplifying their voices in the international debate.

items.title: Statement Regarding the Attack Against Presidential Pre-candidate Miguel Uribe Turbay
items.summary: The YCDI strongly condemns the attack against Senator and presidential pre-candidate Miguel Uribe Turbay, calls for a thorough investigation and rejects all forms of political violence in Colombia.

items.title: Statement of Solidarity for Venezuela
items.summary: The YCDI stands in solidarity with the Venezuelan people, recognizes Edmundo González Urrutia as the lawful president-elect and expresses its concern for the democratic youth of Venezuela facing repression and exile.
